title: The Blue Marble: Land Surface, Ocean Color and Sea Ice
credit: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center. Image by Reto Stöckli; enhancements by Robert Simmon.

Reto Stöckli: clouds in the wider Blue Marble collection
Robert Simmon: 3D globes and animation in the wider collection
additional_collection_data: USGS Terrestrial Remote Sensing Flagstaff Field Center

date.underlying_land_and_coastal_observations: June–September 2001, composited to reduce cloud obstruction
date.note: The server modification date is not an observation date.

asset_type: Global equirectangular UV surface map, not a photograph of a circular disk
recommended_use: Base-color imagery on a sphere with independently computed illumination; use an sRGB texture color space.

rights.statement: NASA Earth Observatory makes this Blue Marble collection freely available for education, science, museums and public use. Retain the credit and follow NASA media usage guidelines; no endorsement is implied.

appearance_limits: Static composite from multiple observations, not a live Earth image or the selected UTC.
This variant contains land, ocean color and sea ice; no separate atmospheric cloud layer is supplied.
Visible continents, seasonal surface appearance and camera orientation must not be presented as the computed view from the selected lunar location.
The texture does not determine Earth visibility, radio access, phase or illumination; those belong to the geometric/model calculations.
local_transformations: None: original official NASA JPEG bytes copied without cropping, resizing, re-encoding or color changes.
